en: A black and white image showing a rectangular, multi-windowed historic building with climbing vines on its walls. The structure has a steep pitched roof with multiple chimneys and dormer windows. There is a circular garden and pathway in front of the entrance and a visible horse-drawn carriage. Surrounding the building are trees and landscaped grounds. Visible on the right side of the roof is the number '1899', possibly indicating a construction or renovation date.
